newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabian treasury bill yields mixed.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabian treasury bill yields mixed.

text.p: Yields were mixed at this week's Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency offering of two billion riyals worth of one, three, six and 12-month treasury bills.
Bankers said the yield on 28-day bills dropped to 5.3965 percent from 5.4175 last week when the bills were for 30 days.

The rate on 91-day paper fell to 5.4677 percent from 5.5425 when the bills were for 98 days. The yield on 182-day bills edged up to 5.6697 percent from 5.6669 and the rate on 364-day treasury bills fell to 5.8687 percent from 5.9208 percent.
The bills were priced at 99.58203, 98.63672, 97.24219 and 94.39844 respectively.
One-month interbank rates were put at 5-9/16, 7/16 percent, three months were at 5-5/8, 1/2 percent, six months were at 5-3/4, 5/8 percent and one-year were at six, 5-7/8 percent.
